name: gtc_10p4m
label: Gran Telescopio Canarias 10.4 m
sources: gtc.iac.es (Introducing the GTC): 36 hexagonal segments, light collecting surface 75.7 m^2, effective collecting area 73 m^2, equivalent to a 10.4 m monolithic mirror.
gtc.iac.es: 10.4 m segmented primary (36 hexagonal segments), 28 45 24 N, 17 53 31 W, about 2300 m; Wikipedia: collecting area 78.54 m^2, altitude 2267 m
notes: collecting_area_m2 73 m^2 is the GTC's stated effective area (75.7 m^2 of segment surface less the obscuration); diameter_m 10.4 is the equivalent circular aperture (78.54 m^2 as a disk, the figure used before 2026-11-10).

Throughput 0.3 (atmosphere + telescope optics to the camera, excl. filter and PDE) is the hbtsim default, not an LPQI number; Prada et al. 2026 (ELTI) adopt an overall instrumental efficiency of 0.5 for a SPAD camera at the focus.
GTC FITS headers carry the INT's coordinates (LATITUDE +28:45:43.2, LONGITUD +17:52:39.5) and are not a GTC position.
